verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 568 Mountain Village Boulevard in Telluride's Mountain Village, surrounded by the San Juan Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Madeline Hotel & Residences is located at 568 Mountain Village Boulevard in the heart of Telluride’s Mountain Village, surrounded by the San Juan Mountains.

verified_facts.text: A complimentary gondola connects the hotel to the historic town of Telluride.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is connected to the historic town of Telluride by a complimentary gondola.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has ski-in/ski-out access at the base of Telluride Ski Resort, with a full-service ski valet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Madeline offers true ski-in/ski-out access at the base of Telluride Ski Resort, with a full-service ski valet just steps from the slopes.

verified_facts.text: The Alpine Swim Club has a heated outdoor pool, two hot tubs and a sundeck with views of the San Juan Mountains.

verified_facts.text: The hotel routinely closes for periods in spring and fall, while the residences remain available.
